artists.biography:
One of New York’s most notable ska bands, the Slackers formed in Brooklyn in 1991 and have played the world over many times since. Their first release was an eponymous self-released album, distributed by Moon Records in 1993 on cassette. Their first real debut is “Better Late Than Never” on moon ska records. Coming out in 1996, this album saw a movement to more traditional ska music, as opposed to their earlier two-tone and garage influences. It was produced by Victor Rice, a noted ska/reggae producer, who also played bass for them at one point.

Band members are as follows:
Vic Ruggiero - Keyboards, Vocals
Jay “Agent Jay” Nugent - Guitar
Dave Hillyard - Saxophone
Glen Pine - Trombone, Vocals
Marcus Geard - Bass
Ara Babajian - Drums

perplexity.description:
Live At Ernesto's! is a live album by The Slackers, originally released in 2000 on Hellcat Records. The album captures a performance recorded in March 1999 at Ernesto's, a restaurant in Sittard, the Netherlands. Musically, it showcases The Slackers' distinctive blend of reggae and rock with strong ska influences, reflecting their signature sound that combines traditional Jamaican rhythms with punk and rock energy. The live setting highlights the band's tight musicianship and dynamic stage presence, delivering extended jams and fan favorites with an organic, raw feel.

Within The Slackers' discography, Live At Ernesto's! stands as an important document of their live performance prowess during the late 1990s, a period when the band was solidifying its reputation in the ska and reggae scenes. The album features tracks from their earlier studio releases, providing a vibrant snapshot of their evolving sound and energetic live interpretations. Critically, the album was well received for its authentic vibe and faithful representation of the band's live energy, though it did not achieve significant commercial chart success. It remains a valued release among fans for capturing the essence of The Slackers' live experience during a formative era of their career.
